metadata.microkernel: IREE 8x8x1 for all three controlled groups; native baseline target-selected
metadata.scope: native Google Benchmark real_time; A packing, GEMM, C unpack, dispatch and output/transient allocation included; parameter archive loading and one-time B packing excluded; no cache flush
metadata.b_lifetime: one IREE pack_b invocation creates shared weights.irpa; each benchmark context initializes immutable B once and reuses across warmup/timed calls

variants.00_dynamic_baseline: original native IREE data-tiling, dynamic A/B; historical reference
variants.00_native_fixed_b: native IREE matmul with immutable raw B; IREE hoists native B packing into context initialization
variants.01_full_a_full_k: full A pack each call, NC/MC/full-K
variants.02_full_a_panel: full A pack each call, NC/KC/MC
variants.03_panel_a_panel: panel A pack each call, NC/KC/MC; A repacked size/NC times
